parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records resides at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift' in the Wallpaper package, which sits under an Examples/SampleApp path and carries is_sample_app=false but is structurally a sample-app file by its directory path (Examples/WallpaperSampleApp). Per the decision rules, any record under Examples/ triggers the sample-app-mirror restraint. Additionally, both records are anonymous type-alias-other declarations with empty fields_or_signature lists and empty name fields, providing no actionable structural evidence to motivate a refactor. The name collision is coincidental given the lack of shared members or any grounding evidence beyond the shared nested type name DisplayLinkSequence.Element.
